title: Dynamic Context Compactor & Robust Tool Log Evaporation
summary: Implemented dynamic compaction trigger in run_agent_loop based on active column context_window (>70% or >20,000 tokens for turns > 3). Enhanced compactor with spilled tool log evaporation (.cvh/spill/), large assistant thought evaporation (embedded <think> blocks and explicit thought messages older than 2 turns), immutable anchor preservation, and intermediate message condensation into a single crisp structured summary block. Fixed compact_context command to use true estimated tokens and persist to SQLite dialog_items.
commitMessage: feat(compactor): dynamic context compaction trigger and robust log evaporation
author: Lead Systems Engineer (agent-developer & tauri-rust-engineer)
